Rust Backend Engineer

Join the platform team building a high-throughput API in Rust. The service runs on Kubernetes, participates in a 24/7 on-call rotation, and owns its own observability stack.

Requirements: production Rust, Kubernetes, gRPC, and experience operating a service under an SLO. You will design schemas, review code, and take part in incident response. The team works flexibly and the role is hybrid in Berlin.

Nice to have: SQLite or embedded storage, desktop clients, and a security background. We value clear writing and small, reversible changes.
